scope: Skia nested inputs and bounded procedural numerical sampler; no native raw texture support

research.finding: Versioned Image exposes makeShader overloads, not a raw image shader constructor; ordinary color image shaders were not substituted.
child(name, Shader) and makeShader allow source-free procedural children; mutable builders are scoped per occurrence.
Actual resolved JVM artifact matches versioned source; no Image raw shader API.

experiment.initial: Dynamic float4 uniform array indexing failed actual JVM SkSL compilation: index expression must be constant.
experiment.bounded_alternative: Public ShaderNode.Companion.rgba8Sampler creates ordinary numerical uniform float4 arrays plus generated constant-index dispatch, at most64texels/256floats/1024uniform bytes. Not a native image/raw texture path and does not change RAW_DATA_TEXTURE support.
experiment.data: RGBA8 UNORM per-channel byte/255, including alpha as independent data; no premultiplication/color conversion in sampler. Parent must form valid premultiplied output.
experiment.filtering: Pixel centers(x+.5,y+.5); nearest floor(coord), bilinear four-neighbor interpolation; clamp/repeat/mirror per neighbor per axis; no mipmaps.
experiment.ownership: Rgba8Data copies caller bytes; helper bounds before bytes() copy. Uniforms and snapshots contain no native state. Native Skia child builders/shaders close after parent retains native references; compiled RuntimeEffects use normal factory LRU.
experiment.policy: Every actual rebind creates fresh child builder/shader and binds its uniform values; controlled playback can avoid refresh for unchanged live revision. No measured upload reduction or performance claim.

coverage: All64RGBA texels checked, RGB consumed even when stored alpha0; alpha remapped as numerical grayscale, sRGB and linear-sRGB raster destination bytes checked.

108nearest/linear/tile/coordinate combinations compared to independent CPU equations; all9axis tiling combinations, pixel centers, negative/outside coordinates, one-texel behavior,65texel rejection and caller mutation.

Raw top-level and late-descendant rejection before native program cache insertion; metadata-known raw/live queries and export avoid provider execution and native compilation.

Invalid child and grandchild compiler errors retain the deepest shaderSource and alias(definition id) path across content creation, session creation/refresh, background and image export. Parent compilation failure retains parent source. Child temporary wrappers remain scoped on failure.

New DataUniform/NestedUniform parent aliases fail bounded declaration preflight before compilation; diagnostics retain parent source. Production sessions capture actual native program source and do not reread mutable manual source getters on refresh or error.

Static content creation and image export capture source once before uniform providers. A provider that mutates a manual source getter cannot replace parent alias-error source or cause a diagnostic reread.

Closed manual Skia and generated definition session owners reject currentRenderEffect getters and refresh, release private current snapshot references, and tolerate repeated close. Caller-held RenderEffect outputs retain identical rendered pixels after owner close and cache/factory disposal. This is ownership correctness, not a native memory stabilization measurement.
